statement: Cancelling between flat booking and signing the Agreement for Lease forfeits the option fee. Cancelling between signing the Agreement for Lease and key collection forfeits 5% of the purchase price. At either stage, the buyer must wait 1 year from the cancellation, and must have paid the forfeiture in full, before applying for (or being an essential occupier in) any of these: a flat bought new from HDB, a CPF-grant-assisted resale flat, a DBSS flat, an EC unit, a SERS resale flat, or an HDB rental flat. First-timer families also lose any additional ballot chances built up for Standard BTO flats.
